Title: AI Engineering, Intern (Milan / Rome)
Description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK 

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 




WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture, and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted. 




WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

The AI Engineering Intern will contribute to the design and development of generative AI applications and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. Working alongside experienced engineers, consultants, and data scientists, you will gain hands-on exposure to the full AI development lifecycle—from early prototyping through to production-ready deployment. This is a learning-first role: you will grow through real project work, close mentorship, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities. As an intern, you will build the technical core of transformations and help move solutions from prototype to real adoption. You will have opportunities to collaborate with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, contributing to real client deployments and shaping how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to the design and development of GenAI applications (e.g., copilots, workflow automation, decision support) using modern LLM stacks.
Support the implementation of AI pipelines and components, including:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
Embedding generation and optimization
Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
Assist in implementing tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
Assist in building agent capabilities including context engineering, memory and state management, orchestration, and tool integration
Support model experimentation, evaluation design, and production deployment tasks alongside senior team members
Write clean, testable code and contribute to APIs and services through the full SDLC: build, test, deploy, monitor, iterate
Contribute to evaluation and observability for GenAI systems: regression test suites, automated scoring, and prompt or policy iteration loops
Gain exposure to responsible AI practices across system design, including:
Implementing guardrails, fallbacks, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
Understanding Bain’s Responsible AI standards and supporting alignment in your work
Contribute to evaluation harnesses and reusable components that scale across client contexts
Contribute to ML solutions end-to-end, including:
Data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, and training
Validation, testing, and performance analysis
Applying appropriate ML methods spanning classical ML and deep learning
Developing working knowledge of transformer fundamentals and LLM concepts
Collaborate with product, engineering, and data science teammates to build well-structured, reliable AI systems
Communicate clearly in working sessions, demos, and documentation—with both technical and non-technical audiences
Support client discussions and documentation as part of broader engagement teams




ABOUT YOU

0–2+ years of professional AI / ML engineering experience, or equivalent through internships, research, academic projects, or open-source contributions
Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in CS, ML, AI, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent early-career experience
Strong academic performance or demonstrated excellence through research, projects, internships, competitions, or open-source contributions
Proficiency in Python and some experience building APIs or services (e.g., REST/gRPC), or comparable project-based experience
Experience building complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
Exposure to retrieval and search systems (e.g., vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking) and familiarity with structured and unstructured data stores
Exposure to agentic patterns (context management, tool integration, orchestration, memory/state handling); hands-on experience preferred
Strong engineering practices: testing, code review, version control, CI/CD, and performance profiling
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; interest in applying AI to real-world business problems in a client-facing environment
Fluency in English and Italian is required

Working Model & Travel 

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office. 
Travel may be required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

We are seeking an ISO ISG Business Operations professional to join our Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG). This full-time role focuses on transforming complex data into actionable insights that support sales strategy, improve business performance, and drive operational excellence in a global environment. The position involves close collaboration with international stakeholders and requires flexibility to align with global time zones, particularly North America.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capabilities, solid business acumen, and the ability to translate data into meaningful recommendations that influence decision-making and support strategic growth.

What You'll Do


Analyze business data and sales behaviors to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities across geographies and functions
Translate complex datasets into clear insights that guide sales strategy and tactical decision-making
Develop and implement data-driven recommendations to support sustainable growth of ISG customers and partner base
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and automated reporting solutions using internal systems and tools (e.g., Power BI)
Collaborate with global stakeholders and regional teams (EMEA, AP, LATAM, North America) to align on priorities and insights
Act as a subject matter expert on sales processes, ensuring best practices and continuous improvement adoption
Deliver regular executive-level updates including forecasts, performance insights, and growth opportunities
Identify and drive process improvements and system enhancements to increase operational efficiency and productivity


What We Look For


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field
Experience in business operations, sales analytics, or a similar data-driven role
Strong technical skills in data analysis tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel advanced, data extraction and modelling)
At least 3-5 years experience working with large, complex datasets and multiple data sources across business systems
Business or operational background (experience in sales environments or ISG/server solutions is an advantage)
Fluent English is required (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable insights
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working in international or multicultural environments


What Lenovo Can Offer You


An open and stimulating environment within one of the most forward thinking IT companies
Flat structures and fast decision-making processes
A modern and flexible way of working to combine personal and professional life
An international team with a high focus on Diversity Inclusion
Attractive compensation package

Title: PowerBI Consultant
Description:
Future Horizons è alla ricerca di un Senior Power BI Consultant, per contribuire alla progettazione di dashboard e report interattivi, curando layout e visualizzazioni per rendere i dati chiari e appealing per uno dei nostri maggiori clienti.

Il suo ruolo sarà orientato a fornire insight immediati e a migliorare la user experience, assicurando che le soluzioni sviluppate siano intuitive e rispondano alle necessità operative e strategiche dell’azienda. Inoltre supporterà il progetto collaborando con il team interno per trasformare i requisiti di business in soluzioni di reporting efficaci. Il consulente assisterà nella raccolta delle esigenze, nella modellazione dei dati e nella definizione di misure e KPI, garantendo che le informazioni siano coerenti e facilmente fruibili.




Il progetto prevede la configurazione di report personalizzati, la gestione delle fonti dati interne, l’implementazione di KPI e la creazione di interfacce user-friendly per gli utenti finali.

Il consulente lavorerà con un team multidisciplinare composto da specialisti commerciali, marketing e SQL, tutti dedicati alla crescita commerciale della società.

Questo approccio collaborativo garantirà che le dashboard non siano solo tecnicamente solide, ma anche allineate alle esigenze di business e alle strategie di mercato. L’obiettivo generale è fornire strumenti di Business Intelligence che migliorino la trasparenza dei conti economici dei clienti e permettano analisi rapide e accurate, favorendo una gestione proattiva delle performance aziendali.




Skills Required




Esperienza avanzata in Power BI: Capacità di sviluppare dashboard e report complessi con funzionalità interattive.
Conoscenza di DAX: Competenza nella scrittura di misure e calcoli complessi per analisi dinamiche.
SQL: Abilità nella lettura e gestione di query SQL per estrazione e manipolazione dati.
Power Query: Esperienza nella pulizia e trasformazione dei dati per garantire coerenza e qualità.
Data Modeling: Capacità di creare modelli dati ottimizzati e relazioni tra tabelle.
ETL Processes: Conoscenza dei processi di estrazione, trasformazione e caricamento dei dati.
Gestione di grandi dataset: Attitudine a lavorare con volumi elevati di dati provenienti da fonti multiple.
UX Design: Sensibilità nella progettazione di interfacce intuitive e orientate all’utente.
Analisi di Business: Comprensione dei conti economici e delle metriche di performance aziendale.
Comunicazione efficace: Capacità di interagire con stakeholder e tradurre esigenze in soluzioni tecniche.




Dettagli Contrattuali




Sede di lavoro: Hybrid Remote (2 gg a settimana on site) a Milano.
Tipologia Contrattuale: Consulente Autonomo Libero Professionista (Partita Iva)
Engagement: Full Time
Durata: Ingaggio iniziale fino a fine 2026 con alta probabilità di estensioni progettuali

Title: Business Analyst - Temporary Contract
Description:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

This role combines strong analytical capabilities, commercial understanding and operational discipline. The Business Analyst, plays a key role in supporting business performance management by ensuring accurate reporting, consistent data flows and clear insights to guide commercial decisions and strategic planning.

The Business Analyst is responsible for supporting the organization through accurate business analysis, sales reporting, performance tracking and data-driven insights. The role supports management, senior analysts and commercial teams by monitoring sales performance at regional, country, channel, brand, customer and door level, ensuring timely visibility on key business trends, risks and opportunities.

He/She is responsible for collecting, consolidating and analyzing sell-in, sell-out and sell-thru data, preparing business reports, dashboards and presentations, and supporting the Budget, Forecast, Monthly Revenue Forecast and strategic planning processes. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, high attention to detail and a solid understanding of sales dynamics, distribution networks, KPIs and business performance drivers.

,

Business Analysis And Sales Performance Tracking


Regularly deliver business analysis of sales performance at regional, country, channel, brand, customer and door level.
Monitor top-line results and provide clear visibility on key business trends, risks and opportunities.
Support the analysis of business performance, developing a solid understanding of each market and distribution model.
Track regional distribution across all channels and maintain updated visibility on business evolution by market.


Reporting, Dashboards And KPIs


Define, maintain and update sales dashboards by area and at consolidated level, focusing on key market KPIs.
Prepare weekly and monthly sell-out tracking and reporting.
Collect, consolidate and analyze sell-out and sell-thru data from partners and internal systems.
Support the creation and maintenance of databases to capture sales data
Ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability of data flows, inputs and analysis.


Budget, Forecast And Business Planning Support


Support the preparation of Budget and Forecast templates by partner, door and brand.
Support the preparation of Monthly Revenue Forecasts through data analysis and business input consolidation.
Track sell-in orders and support selling campaign forecasting.
Confirm End of Market results to HQ, ensuring timely and accurate reporting.


,

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field.

Experience


Previous experience in Business Analysis, Sales Analysis, Business Intelligence, Commercial Planning or a similar analytical role.
Experience in the fashion, retail, wholesale or travel retail industry is a plus.
Strong experience with Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of Power BI or other business intelligence / data visualization tools is a strong plus.


Skills


Strong analytical mindset, with a natural attitude for numbers and data interpretation.
Good understanding of sales dynamics, distribution networks, partners, customers and competitor landscape.
Ability to analyze large sets of data and translate them into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong knowledge of business KPIs, sales performance metrics and reporting processes.
Excellent planning, organizational and time-management skills.
Good communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively.
Fluent in English.


Personal Attributes


Curious, open-minded and proactive team player, with strong sense of initiative.
Hands-on approach, problem-solving attitude and ability to manage multiple priorities.
High attention to detail, accuracy and consistency.
Willingness to learn, improve processes and share knowledge across the team.
Starting base salary equal to € 30.000 (full-time). Once the successful candidate is selected, the salary offer will be based on objective and gender-neutral criteria such as experience, skills, responsibilities, and location.
Contractual level: CCNL Commercio - Level 4. Temporary contract 12 months.
Meal Vouchers: €8.65/day per worked day of at least 6 hours.

Title: Digital Analytics Specialist
Description:
We are looking for a Digital Analytics Specialist to join our Marketing team in Milan and play a key strategic role in data interpretation and advanced analytics.




This role will work at the intersection of Marketing, Tech and UX, with the mission to ensure data accuracy, unlock actionable insights, and support data-driven decision making across channels, brand partners.




As a key analytical partner, you will manage tracking systems, improve the quality of data flows, and collaborate on advanced analysis, modeling, and visualization to optimize marketing performance and strategic outcomes. You will also translate on-site user behavior data into concrete hypotheses on user experience, partnering with the UX/Product team to prioritize improvements to our digital touchpoints.




What you'll do:

Ensure the quality, consistency, and reliability of all collected data, and guarantee they're correctly implemented and visualized across platforms (GA4, dashboards, BI tools) and ready for reporting needs.
Configure and maintain custom GA4 reports to analyze website performance and user interactions (e.g., scrolls, videos, wish lists, product rankings) and extract strategic insights.
Analyze on-site behavioral data — funnel drop-offs, rage clicks, scroll depth, session recordings and heatmaps to identify friction points across the user journey, and translate findings into clear, actionable UI/UX recommendations for the Product/UX team.
Build and maintain customer journey maps across key touchpoints, highlighting drop-off and conversion points to help prioritize experimentation and optimization efforts.
Partner with Brand Marketing and Channels teams to set up advanced analysis frameworks and test alternative attribution models.
Collaborate with Tech team to develop and manage customized dashboards, integrating GA4 events and performance metrics, to deliver deep insights into user journeys and conversion funnels.
Research, propose, and contribute to the implementation of predictive models, including customer segmentation and behaviours, using machine learning and statistical algorithms.
Monitor tracking anomalies on GA4, escalate technical issues to the Tech team, and support their resolution.
Encourage data literacy through regular training sessions and process documentation/standardization.




What we're looking for:

3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a marketing, e-commerce, or digital environment.
Educational background in Data Science, Economics, Data analysis, or related fields.
Strong command of GA4 and digital analytics tools; experience with BigQuery and Google Tag Manager is a plus.
Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau).
Solid understanding of marketing performance metrics, attribution models, and user behavior analytics.
Hands-on experience with behavioral analytics / session-recording tools, and the ability to read quantitative and qualitative signals together to form UX hypotheses.

AI & AUTOMATION ENGINEER

Per realtà innovativa e in forte crescita nel mondo della Customer Experience e dell'automazione, ricerchiamo due AI & Automation Engineer che entreranno a far parte di un team specializzato nello sviluppo di soluzioni avanzate di automazione basate su Intelligenza Artificiale.   • Partecipazione attiva all'evoluzione delle soluzioni di Conversational e Voice AI in contesti di Customer Care.

Requisiti

  • Seniority ideale 5 anni di esperienza;
  • Esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di automazione basate su AI e Machine Learning;
  • Ottima conoscenza di Python;
  • Esperienza nell'utilizzo delle API dei principali provider di Intelligenza Artificiale;
  • Conoscenza di Prompt Engineering, Function Calling, Structured Outputs, Tool Use e AI Agents;
  • Esperienza con modelli LLM (fine-tuning, valutazione performance, ottimizzazione prompt);
  • Esperienza nello sviluppo di API REST e integrazioni backend;
  • Familiarità con JavaScript/TypeScript e SQL;
  • Familiarità con architetture a microservizi, Docker;
  • Familiarità con strumenti di versionamento e pratiche DevOps (Git, CI/CD);
  • Si considera come plus l'esperienza con piattaforme di Conversational e Voice AI;
  • Conoscenza intermedia della lingua inglese per lavorare su progetti internazionali.


Soft skills

  • Forte orientamento operativo e autonomia nella gestione delle attività;
  • Curiosità tecnica e approccio pragmatico nella risoluzione dei problemi;
  • Mentalità di troubleshooting strutturata: capacità di analisi, investigazione e problem solving;
  • Attitudine ad apprendere rapidamente e a mettersi in discussione;
  • Buona cultura generale dello sviluppo software, anche senza una specializzazione su singoli linguaggi;
  • Capacità di lavorare sia in autonomia sia in collaborazione con il team;
  • Buone doti relazionali: persona proattiva, comunicativa e integrata nel contesto di team


Cosa offriamo

  • Un ambiente positivo, inclusivo e innovativo, con un team giovane e stimolante e progetti sfidanti in un contesto orientato alla trasformazione digitale;
  • Sede di lavoro: Paderno Dugnano (Milano);
  • Smart working: 2 giorni a settimana, con flessibilità modulabile anche su base mensile;
  • Smart week: il venerdì si lavora in Smart Working fino alle 13:00;
  • Formazione continua su tecnologie e metodologie di automazione;
  • Opportunità concrete di crescita professionale all'interno dell'azienda.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR

We help large enterprises cut energy costs and valorize flexibility by steering their energy use in sync with market prices and renewable generation.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to develop the forecasting, optimization, and control algorithms at the core of Companion's platform.

You'll work on energy demand forecasting, market price prediction, and real-time asset control: models and algorithms that drive second-by-second decisions worth millions.




About Companion.energy

Companion.energy connects the financial side of energy management (contracts, markets, risk) with the operational side (assets, processes, sites). We model complex energy contracts and flexible assets, forecast demand and production, and translate predictions into automated, second-by-second control decisions that move megawatts and money. Our software is used by large B2B enterprises and energy players to lower OPEX, maximize revenue, increase renewable usage, and manage risk.




Why Companion.energy?

Work on hard problems: Real-time forecasting, optimization, and closed-loop control in complex, stochastic energy systems. Your models and controllers move megawatts.
See your work in production: Models you build get deployed and measured against real financial outcomes daily. Controllers you design steer real assets in real time.
Join early, help shape the future: Small team, big impact. You'll shape Companion's data, ML, and control strategy.
A mission that matters: Better forecasting and smarter control accelerate the transition to a flexible, renewable grid.




What you'll work on

Forecasting models for energy demand, renewable production, and market prices — including the uncertainty estimates that feed downstream control.
Control algorithms that translate forecasts and market signals into real-time asset dispatch decisions (battery steering, load shifting, balancing market participation), accounting for the inherent stochasticity of prices, generation, and demand.
Optimization pipelines that schedule flexibility across portfolios of assets and markets under uncertainty.
Closing the loop: connecting prediction, planning, and execution into systems that operate autonomously in a stochastic environment.




What we are looking for

Strong foundation in machine learning, time series forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience with control algorithms: model predictive control (MPC), stochastic optimal control, or similar approaches to real-time decision-making under uncertainty and constraints.
Proficiency in Python and the standard data/scientific computing stack (pandas, NumPy/SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent).
Experience with short-term power or flexibility trading
Experience working with real-world, messy time series data.
Comfort deploying models and control algorithms in production environments, not just notebooks.
Interest in or knowledge of energy systems: electricity markets, load forecasting, asset dispatch, balancing mechanisms, or related domains.
Pragmatic approach: you understand the difference between a theoretically optimal solution and one that ships and delivers value under real-world uncertainty.
Experience with mathematical optimization (linear/quadratic programming, mixed-integer formulations, stochastic programming) is a strong plus.




Location

Belgium (hybrid)




How we hire

Intro call → technical case → follow-up conversations with the team and founders.

We keep it simple and can move fast.




Ready to apply?

Send a short email to apply@companion.energy with your resume attached. Tell us why this role excites you and share something relevant: a model you built, a control system you designed, a Kaggle notebook, or a project that shows how you approach data and engineering problems.

Design, build, and deploy predictive and prescriptive ML models.

Continuously optimize, fine-tune, and improve model performance.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium

Company: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium

Employment Type: Full-time




Nature of the Tasks

Collaborate with stakeholders to collect requirements, frame business problems as data science hypotheses, define success metrics, and develop or deploy advanced data mining and machine learning solutions.
Collaborate with User Experience (UX) and product teams to specify design requirements for the effective presentation and interpretation of model outputs and insights.
Develop process to monitor and analyse data accuracy.
Identify, collect, and prepare data for analysis, collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure robust production-grade data pipelines, with a focus on feature engineering and data readiness for modelling.
Produce data models according to specific problem statements.
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and scripts to solve specific business problems.
Collaborate with Data Analysts and Architects on the design of the analytics architecture to ensure it supports the scalability and performance requirements of data science models.
Write the different documentation associated with the tasks and liaise with other teams as necessary to address cross-system interdependencies.
Develop visualizations to communicate model behaviour, key insights, and performance metrics, and collaborate with Data Analysts on integrated dashboard reporting.
Design, develop, and evaluate predictive models capable of handling both structured and unstructured data, including model selection, training, and hyperparameter tuning.
Elaborate processes to ensure the compliant implementation of regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act), including model risk management, monitoring for drift/bias, and comprehensive documentation (e.g., model cards).
Ensure that model development, deployment, and monitoring practices adhere to all relevant regulatory frameworks and internal governance policies.
Communicate model insights, limitations, and behaviour effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, and create interpretable outputs and documentation.
Conduct rigorous experiment design (e.g., A/B testing), employ cross-validation techniques, and perform statistical significance testing to validate findings and model performance.
Deploy and maintain models into production using Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, model registries, and ensuring reproducibility.




Specific Expertise and Technologies

Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques and tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, Spark) to design and implement data-driven solutions.
Knowledge of machine learning and natural language processing (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) to build predictive and text-based models.
Knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL; Perl optional) commonly used in data science for modelling and automation.
Knowledge of MLOps practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, model registry, unit testing frameworks) to ensure reproducibility and quality in model delivery.
Knowledge of business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, SAS, SAP Analytics) to visualise and communicate model outputs and insights.
Knowledge of data engineering and ETL processes using tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory) to prepare training datasets.
Knowledge of data storage and query technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Hadoop) to extract and process data at scale.
Knowledge of designing scalable data storage solutions (e.g., data lakes, lakehouses, distributed stores) for advanced analytics and AI workloads.
Knowledge of advanced analytics applications such as forecasting, recommendation systems, anomaly detection, or sentiment analysis for business impact.
Knowledge of AI governance principles (e.g., transparency, explainability, fairness, accountability) aligned with emerging EU AI Act requirements.
Knowledge of AI compliance, risks, and mitigation practices (e.g., bias monitoring, drift detection, model cards).
Knowledge of data and AI regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, EU AI Act) and ability to design models compliant with legal and ethical standards.
Knowledge of experiment design (e.g., A/B testing, cross-validation, significance testing) to validate models rigorously.
Knowledge of model deployment practices (e.g., containerization, APIs, serving frameworks) to operationalise machine learning solutions.




Minimum Level of Expertise

Normal

Certification and/or Standards

Optional: A certification directly related to the requested profile.

Optional for 'Normal' level and above related to Public Cloud: One of the following or an equivalent certification:

AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
Azure AI Engineer Associate




Skills

Ability to frame business problems, form hypotheses, and design solutions.
Skill in presenting models and insights clearly to all audiences.
Commitment to accuracy, reproducibility, and integrity in models.
Ability to design and test approaches for complex challenges.
Competence in managing experiments, pipelines, and deliverables.
Drive to explore new algorithms, frameworks, and AI methods.
Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
Flexibility to adopt new ML/AI tools and frameworks.
Capability to frame model results into compelling business stories.
Ability to participate in multilingual meetings.
Ability to understand, speak and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously.
Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering.

Title: Financial Risk Modeler - Data Scientist
Description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? You’re not alone. Join us in driving progress in the working world and beyond.

Your journey with us

Deloitte Belgium’s Financial Risk department helps organizations identify the risks impacting their business and implement effective and efficient processes to measure and manage these risks (mainly market, credit and liquidity risk). To this end, the team leverages its expertise in data analytics, machine learning techniques and process optimization, combined with a strong understanding of the regulatory and business context.

As a Quantitative Modeler, you will be developing, validating and implementing advanced mathematical and statistical models to address complex financial and business challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong academic background, experience in quantitative methods, and a deep understanding of financial instruments and markets.

What will you be doing?

You Will Join a Team Of Experienced Risk Modelers Where Collaboration And Communication Are At The Heart Of Our Way Of Working. You Are Curious And Analytical, With a Natural Drive To Excel. Amongst Other, Your Activities Will Include


Model Development: Design and develop quantitative models for risk management, utilizing techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation and machine learning.
Model Validation: Conduct rigorous back-testing and validation of models, ensuring their robustness and alignment with regulation and market conditions.
Data Analysis & Interpretation: Analyze large datasets to identify trends, relationships, and patterns. Work with financial and market data to derive insights for model improvement and validation.
Process Optimization: Analyze process workflow and advise on improvements to facilitate experience in model application, maintenance, and internal and regulatory reporting.
Research & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest research in quantitative finance, machine learning, and statistical techniques. Apply new methodologies and tools to improve existing models and develop new strategies.


Let's Talk About You


You have a Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Business or Financial Engineering / Economics or Computer Science.
You have between 2 and 5 years of experience in quantitative modeling and/or validation, preferably in financial services, with hands-on experience with programming languages such as Python, R, Matlab or SAS/SQL.
You demonstrate understanding of business processes, regulatory requirements, internal control risk management, process, data and technology controls and related standards and frameworks.
You are fluent in English and Dutch or French.


Soft Skills


Quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills, with high capacity for solving challenging business problems
Present complex quantitative concepts and findings in a clear and accessible manner to stakeholders at various levels of technical expertise.
Strong analytical thinking and a drive for continuous learning and improvement, tech-savvy
Ability to work in a collaborative, team-based environment


How will you grow?


You will further develop your expertise across a broad range of quantitative applications in risk.
As you grow, you will be given more responsibility to manage assignments working directly with senior members of our client teams and guide junior colleagues.
As you become proficient in various skill sets, you will coach your colleagues and continue to enhance your management competencies.


Our story

Our Risk, Regulatory & Forensic practice is a global leader in helping clients manage risk and uncertainty from the boardroom to the network. We provide a broad array of services that allow our clients around the world to better measure, manage and control risk to enhance the reliability of systems and processes throughout their organization.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:


My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities


Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements remains essential in today's reality:


Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.


Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

Title: R&D Data Scientist | Automotive
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Your Role

As an R&D Data Scientist, you will play a key role in:


Analysing vehicle telemetry, driving data, and unstructured data sources (including verbatim text) to build interpretable features and dimensions that define driving patterns and behaviours.
Linking real-world telemetry data with survey responses, customer personas, and behavioural indicators to generate a rich, multi-dimensional understanding of driver profiles.
Reviewing relevant academic and technical literature, assessing applicability to the project, and rapidly testing approaches through proof-of-concepts on real, messy data.
Comparing and validating analytical methods — including clustering, dimensionality reduction, factor analysis, and supervised/unsupervised modelling — with rigorous attention to robustness, reliability, and limitations.
Collaborating with engineers to ensure findings are technically grounded, and communicating results clearly with well-reasoned recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Your Profile


Technical depth: Strong proficiency in Python for analysis, modelling and prototyping, combined with solid foundations in statistics, machine learning and AI — including feature engineering, dimensionality reduction and model validation.
Applied research capability: Able to read and critically assess technical material, adapt methods to real-world constraints, and design experiments on complex, ambiguous datasets — going well beyond running standard pipelines.
Engineering sensitivity: You understand what your data physically and behaviourally represents, and can judge whether results make sense in context — not just statistically, but meaningfully.
Communication and autonomy: You work independently, structure your own analyses, challenge weak or ambiguous results, and clearly communicate assumptions, limitations and conclusions to diverse audiences.
Fluent in English
Minimum 4 years of experience


What You Will Love About Working Here


Empowering environment - Autonomy and Goal setting are among the top scores with 8,4+ ratings in our monthly employee feedback Pulse.
FlexAbroad - Employees in 20+ countries can work abroad for up to 45 days in a 12-month period.
Free access to learning platforms - Free access for all to world-class learning assets and curated programs from Harvard Business Review, Coursera, Pluralsight, Udemy, Microsoft, AWS, Google and many more.
Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services - Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleashing their R&D potential to develop smart products and services of tomorrow.


Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Science Specialist, you’ll collaborate in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3–6 experts, using your creativity and analytics expertise to drive client performance in areas like energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You’ll work side-by-side with client process engineers and analytics specialists, presenting your insights directly to executive audiences.

Internally, you’ll partner with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms that address both current and future client needs. You’ll play a key role in codifying best practices, amplifying our impact both inside and outside the firm, and shaping the product roadmap.

You’ll be based in our Brussels office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution, OptimusAI, which sits at the intersection of three practices: Global Energy and Materials, QuantumBlack, and Operations.

Global Energy and Materials: Advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.

QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey: The AI arm of our firm, helping clients transform faster, innovate smarter, and anticipate the future.

Operations: Assists clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing strategies and solutions for their most critical problems—connecting boardroom strategies to shop floor operators.

At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics. We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in plant control rooms, optimize process control systems, and unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.

OptimusAI also supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying our approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You’ll benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. Experience unparalleled career growth, with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. Plus, seize the opportunity to travel to client sites—locally and around the world.

There is a flexibility to hire at different role level, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics, ideally within heavy industry environments
Advanced Python programming skills, with a passion for writing clean, efficient, modular, and maintainable code
Proven ability to implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for seamless model integration and deployment
Strong DevOps and backend engineering capabilities, including experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Self-starter with excellent organizational abilities—able to independently initiate tasks and drive them to completion
Skilled in making rational, data-driven decisions based on facts and logical reasoning
Ability to create high-quality work products, such as PowerPoint presentations, Excel models, articles, or other written outputs
Exceptional time management skills to thrive in a complex, largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to work or attend meetings outside traditional business hours, and to take on projects at short notice when needed
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences and seniority levels

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Omschrijving

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

De job in een notendop

AI- & ML-solution development:


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur:


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie:


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance:


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement:


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van:
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, enz.

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (NL/FR).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Machine Learning & Operations Research Specialist
Description:
bpost strives to create an inclusive environment with challenging projects and inspiring collaborations. With our colleagues at the heart of our organisation, we believe in careers rather than jobs. As part of the international group bnode, bpost has transitioned from the Belgian postal operator to a regional and digital expert in parcel size logistics. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, our people are the foundation of everything we do. We foster a culture that supports diversity, inclusion and career growth, ensuring that every team member has the opportunity to thrive and succeedWhat will you do?

Bpost is looking for a Data Scientist / Operations Research Specialist with proven experience building and industrializing machine learning and optimization solutions.

In Belgium, Bpost operates in a context of structural mail decline, continued parcel growth, increasing operational variability, and strong competitive pressure. Better forecasting and optimization are therefore key to improving service (quality) and network efficiency (cost) across sorting, transport and distribution.

In this role, you will design, prototype and industrialize analytical solutions that drive operational and tactical decisions across Bpost’s network. This includes building robust decision-support tools such as forecasting and optimization models, and ensuring they are deployed, monitored and used in real operations.

You will work closely with operational stakeholders and IT teams to turn business problems into scalable, production-ready solutions. You will also help increase the analytics maturity of Bpost by moving use cases from ad hoc analysis or prototype stage toward robust, reusable and business-embedded analytical products.

Who are you?


At least 5 years of proven experience using both machine learning and operations research to solve real-world problems
At least 5 years of proven experience designing, prototyping, deploying, and monitoring models in production environments
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic analytical solutions
Interest in logistics, supply chain, and physical network decision-making
Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Full proficiency in English. French and Dutch are a strong plus.


Tools & Technologies (Indicative Stack)


Programming & analytics: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn
ML & forecasting: XGBoost, LightGBM, time series models
Optimization: OR-Tools, Gurobi or similar solvers
Engineering: Git, Airflow, Docker, CI/CD tooling
Versioning & experimentation: MLflow, DVC, Weights & Biases, or similar
Platforms: Conveyor, Databricks, Spark, Snowflake-connected environments, or similar cloud-based platforms
AI & agentic systems: familiarity with LLM-based applications, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, or similar emerging technologies for decision support and workflow automation


What We Provide


The opportunity to create tangible impact at national scale by improving services that are used every day by millions of people, households, and businesses across Belgium
High-visibility analytical challenges at the intersection of machine learning, optimization, and real-world operations


What do we offer?

Like a Long-awaited Parcel, We Want To Make You Feel Welcome And Valued. Our Offer Includes a Competitive Monthly Salary, That Goes Without Saying. On Top Of That, You Can Count On


Meal vouchers of €8 per working day
Hospitalization-, group- and disability insurances
A phone subscription, including 25GB data
A flexible renumeration plan, which allows you to customize your own benefits. A company car, bike leasing, public transportation, extra days off,... the choice is yours
Possibility to enter the Federal Mobility plan
Work/life balance, thanks to flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
20 days of statutory leave and 7 additional extralegal days off
An end-of-year and performance-based bonus and double holiday pay
Many benefits from more than 100 Bpost-partners

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Let's build the future of AI & Data, together 🧙

At Data Wizards, we're focused on 3 things: Data, AI & you.

We're a small team who genuinely love digging into data that makes a real difference for the companies we work with, and who want to discover how AI and data can help companies out there.

Why join us? Apart from tackling exciting challenges with passionate people in an environment that wants to see you thrive, you'll be part of a young company that keeps its feet on the ground, its eyes on the stars, and believes the best growth comes from the unique magic each Wizard brings.

We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. But this job description is for Senior Data Scientists out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄

We are currently looking for a senior data scientist for a fraud detection project where you would do:


Strengthening our fraud models by improving how we collect, label, structure and engineer features from complex transactional and behavioral data
Designing, building and continuously refining fraud detection models using machine learning, graph analytics, anomaly detection and behavioral analytics
Turning large volumes of transactional and customer data into actionable fraud intelligence through feature engineering, data enrichment and pattern discovery
Partnering with Fraud Operations, Risk, Compliance and Product teams to spot emerging fraud trends and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions
Digging into complex fraud schemes, uncovering new attack vectors and building proactive detection strategies that protect the business financially and reputationally
But being a consulting company, we can't know in advance what your exact responsibilities will be



You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:

Background


At least 5 years of experience in data science, with a solid grounding in fraud detection, ideally within the financial sector
A Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science or engineering. A PhD is a plus, and candidates with a different academic background but strong analytical skills are equally welcome



Technical Skills


Hands-on experience processing large-scale, complex transactional and behavioral datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas) and distributed processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop
Proven ability to apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics and network analysis to detect, investigate and prevent fraud. Experience with generative AI is a plus
Strong Python skills, with experience deploying AI applications into production; familiarity with Java is a plus



Soft Skills


Autonomous & Proactive: You take initiative and drive projects forward.
Curious & Adaptive: You embrace learning and thrive in dynamic environments.
Solution-Oriented: You balance technical rigor with business impact.
Clear Communicator: You simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.
Collaborative & Supportive: You work well in teams.
Creative Thinker: You find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
Languages: Fluent in English, French and/or Dutch.



We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.

Here's a sneak peek at what we offer:

💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated


Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
Opportunity to earn company stock over time



🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive


Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week

Title: VIE – Data Scientist & Data Analyst (H/F) – Belgique
Description:
Contexte et environnement

Au sein de TotalEnergies Charging Solutions Belgium (TCSB), filiale de la branche Marketing & Services de TotalEnergies, l'entité Data intervient sur les activités d'analyse de données, de data science et de transformation des plateformes de données pour les activités de recharge de véhicules électriques.

L'équipe Data accompagne les besoins métiers de la filiale depuis l'identification des cas d'usage jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de solutions analytiques et prédictives, en passant par la collecte, l'exploitation et la valorisation des données.

Vérifiez votre éligibilité au programme ainsi que les spécificités pays sur le site internet : https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/qu-est-ce-que-le-volontariat-international

Merci de candidater en anglais.

Activités

Vos principales missions :

Développement de modèles prédictifs et de solutions Data Science


Participer à la création de modèles prédictifs appliqués aux activités de recharge pour véhicules électriques.
Exploiter et analyser des données afin d'optimiser l'implantation des bornes de recharge, les coûts d'installation et les opérations de maintenance.
Exploiter et analyser des volumes importants de données internes et externes.
Développer de nouvelles solutions Data Science.



Migration et transformation des plateformes de données


Accompagner les projets de migration de plateformes et de transformation des environnements de données.
Développer et adapter des traitements, dashboards, modèles analytiques et solutions de reporting pour les équipes métier.
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'architecture data locale et à la structuration des flux de données.
Développer des modèles analytiques, des outils de visualisation et des solutions de reporting à destination des équipes métiers.
Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles belges ainsi qu'avec les équipes Data et Digital du siège afin de répondre aux besoins métiers et d'accompagner les évolutions des outils.



Le poste combine des activités Data Analysis (50%) et Data Scientist Analysis (50%), centré sur l'analyse de données, la modélisation prédictive et la transformation des plateformes data dans le domaine de la mobilité électrique.

Profil du candidat

Diplômé d'un Bac+5 minimum en Data Science, Data Engineering, (école de commerce ou université.)

Vous bénéficiez d'une première expérience en Data Science, Data Analytics.

La connaissance du secteur de l'énergie constitue un atout.

Vous disposez de compétences en :


Databricks ;
Snowflake ;
Clustering ;
Segmentation ;
Scoring ;



Vous maîtrisez les outils suivants :


Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) ;
SQL ;
Modèles de Machine Learning (Modélisation prédictive).



Un niveau d'anglais B2/C1 est requis. Un niveau de français C1 minimum est également demandé. La connaissance du néerlandais constitue un atout.

Informations supplémentaires

Date de début : Q4 2026

TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Position Description

The opportunity

Join CGI's multidisciplinary innovation environment and help clients turn data into decisions, products and new ways of working. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will frame complex business questions, design robust analytical approaches and build AI and machine-learning solutions that create practical value.

You will combine technical delivery with consulting: translating emerging trends into relevant client solutions, making insights easy to understand, supporting business development and helping less-experienced colleagues grow.

Only candidates legally residing in Belgium will be considered for this position.

C2-level in one of the 2 national languages and at least B2-level in the other and strong English proficiency is also mandatory.

What you will do


Frame the right problems. Work with clients and multidisciplinary teams to translate business challenges into clear analytical questions, hypotheses, success measures and realistic delivery plans.
Build advanced analytics solutions. Develop, evaluate and improve machine-learning and statistical models for classification, regression, forecasting, NLP and other relevant use cases.
Create reliable experiments. Explore and prepare data, select appropriate methods, design experiments and validate results with attention to quality, bias, explainability and business relevance.
Make insights actionable. Translate model outputs and complex findings into clear visualisations, recommendations and narratives that decision-makers can understand and use.
Support industrialisation. Collaborate with data, software and cloud engineers to move promising models towards secure, maintainable and scalable production solutions.
Shape client strategy and growth. Connect industry and technology trends to client operations, contribute to workshops and proposals, and help create new opportunities with existing and prospective CGI clients.
Mentor and collaborate. Coach colleagues, review approaches and share good practices while working openly with experts from different disciplines to find the strongest solution.


What you bring


Relevant education and experience. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Econometrics or another discipline with a strong statistical component, plus at least 5 years of experience in the data domain.
Python and/or R. Strong practical skills with the data-science ecosystem, including tools such as pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, matplotlib or equivalent libraries.
Machine learning and advanced analytics. Proven experience solving complex problems through data analysis, modelling and evaluation, including classification and regression techniques.
Natural language processing. Experience with NLP concepts and libraries such as spaCy, NLTK or Stanford NLP, and the ability to select an appropriate approach for the use case.
Data and cloud platforms. Experience with advanced analytics and large datasets, together with practical knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
Consulting and communication. Strong problem-solving, stakeholder and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical choices and results to non-specialist audiences.
Agile collaboration. Comfort working iteratively in Agile environments, taking ownership of deliverables and collaborating across business, data, engineering and design disciplines.
Additional assets. Experience in software development or DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, MLOps, computer vision, Unity, Linked Data, semantic technologies or knowledge graphs is an advantage.


A pre-employment screening is part of the application process.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: AI Engineer - AI Lab (kantoor Antwerpen)
Description:
Delen Private Bank is gespecialiseerd in discretionair vermogensbeheer en vermogensplanning. Onze missie? Het vermogen van onze klanten op een actieve en doordachte manier beheren en plannen, met het oog op een evenwichtige groei en een vlotte overdracht naar de volgende generaties. Persoonlijk contact, een langetermijnvisie en een duurzame aanpak kenmerken onze filosofie. Groep Delen is actief in vijf landen en telt meer dan 1000 medewerkers.




Het AI Lab binnen Delen Private Bank

De gedeelde missie van business, IT en het AI Lab is het vereenvoudigen en ondersteunen van processen, zodat collega’s minder administratieve lasten ervaren en meer tijd kunnen besteden aan persoonlijk contact met klanten en een uitstekende dienstverlening.




In het AI Lab luisteren we naar onze collega’s om hun uitdagingen in processen en werkmethoden te begrijpen, en verkennen we waar AI hen echt kan ondersteunen. Daarna bouwen we AI‑oplossingen om de meerwaarde voor onze collega’s concreet te maken. Wanneer die duidelijk is en er vraag ontstaat, neemt IT de oplossing over voor verdere uitwerking binnen onze systemen.




AI Engineer binnen het AI Lab

Als AI Engineer speel je een sleutelrol in het onderzoeken, ontwerpen en bouwen van AI‑oplossingen en capabilities die bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kwaliteit en schaalbaarheid van onze dienstverlening. Je opereert op het kruispunt van business, data, software engineering & AI.

Je bouwt end‑to‑end AI‑oplossingen: van data‑ingestion en modelontwikkeling tot concrete applicaties waarmee we de business versneld kunnen ondersteunen.
Wanneer een oplossing succesvol is en de business er klaar voor is, dragen we deze over aan IT voor volledige integratie. Onze rol is dan puur adviserend.
Je bouwt AI‑services die veilig, uitlegbaar en performant zijn, en je waakt over stabiliteit, monitoring en lifecycle management van modellen in productie.
Je denkt actief mee over architectuurkeuzes, herbruikbare componenten en best practices binnen het AI Lab.




Jouw profiel

Wat breng je high-level mee?

Minstens 2 jaar ervaring in een AI-, ML- of Software Engineering‑rol, waarbij je technische expertise combineert met een pragmatische, proactieve aanpak gericht op business value.

Jouw achtergrond & basis vaardigheden:

Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om technische concepten helder over te brengen aan business stakeholders
Gedrevenheid om waarde te leveren en collega’s te helpen
Diepgaande kennis van Python en solide softwareprincipes
Aantoonbare ervaring in het bouwen van LLM‑applicaties in een productieomgeving
Ervaring met Git en versiebeheer (GitHub)
Ervaring met Docker & GitHub Actions
Ervaring in data cleansing en feature engineering (Python & SQL)
Oog voor datakwaliteit en metadata‑management
Aandacht voor access management en het veilig omgaan met gevoelige data
Kennis/ervaring met RAG‑systemen (embeddingstrategieën, vector databases, retrieval, guardrails, evaluatie, QA, …)
Ervaring met cloudplatformen, bij voorkeur Azure
Gevorderde promptingtechnieken
Een echte teamspeler die graag samenwerkt, kennis deelt en nieuwe technologieën verkent
Liefst werk je in tandem, zowel binnen het AI Lab als met de businesscollega’s
Vloeiende kennis Nederlands en Engels




Extra punten indien:

Ervaring binnen de financiële sector
Ervaring met Pydantic, LangChain, LangGraph, …
Ervaring met workflow orchestration
Ervaring in webapplicatie‑ontwikkeling (front‑ en/of backend)
Een actief GitHub‑profiel
Ervaring met multi‑agent frameworks
Een echte teamspeler die graag samenwerkt, kennis deelt en nieuwe technologieën verkent




Andere verwachtingen:

Bij Delen Private Bank geloven we in betere samenwerking door aanwezigheid op kantoor. “By default” werk je vanuit Antwerpen, met ad‑hoc uitzonderingen mogelijk.
Je hebt passie voor je vak en gaat van nature de extra mile in een dynamische, voortdurend evoluerende omgeving.
De collega’s zijn onze klanten. Je bent gemotiveerd om met hen samen te werken, duurzame relaties op te bouwen en steeds in tandem te werken.




Wij bieden

Aantrekkelijke voorwaarden: je ontvangt een competitief salaris aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket extralegale voordelen, zoals hospitalisatie- en tandzorgverzekering, groepsverzekering, ecocheques, gsm met abonnement, optieplan, extra verlofdagen (bank holidays), Benefits at Work, restaurant met versbereide maaltijden, keuze uit bedrijfswagen of andere (mobiliteits)oplossingen via het mobiliteitsbudget.
Ontwikkelkansen & intrapreneurship: jouw groei staat centraal. We luisteren naar je ambities en helpen je actief om stappen te zetten binnen onze organisatie. Via opleidingen, interne mobiliteit en intrapreneurship krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan. Jij bent de architect van je loopbaan – wij zorgen voor de juiste ondersteuning.
Persoonlijke aanpak: als familiebedrijf sinds 1936 geloven we in de kracht van een persoonlijke aanpak. Je werkt in een warme en betrokken omgeving waar je écht gezien wordt. Dankzij onze vlakke structuur zijn de lijnen kort en is de directie – inclusief de familie – bereikbaar en betrokken. Ideeën krijgen snel gehoor, beslissingen worden doortastend genomen.
Collegiale sfeer: samenwerken zit in ons DNA. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar collega’s elkaar ondersteunen, kennis delen en elkaar motiveren. We werken in een open en toegankelijke sfeer aan gedeelde doelen – met succes én met ruimte voor humor.
Duurzame samenwerking: we bouwen aan relaties voor de lange termijn – met onze klanten én onze medewerkers. Ons zeer laag personeelsverloop is daar het bewijs van. Dankzij een cultuur van vertrouwen, open communicatie en stabiliteit krijg je de kans om samen met ons te groeien.
